title: Sonic The Hedgehog Shadow 2.5” Figure Jakks Pacific Sealed Articulated
descriptionText:
Sonic The Hedgehog Shadow articulated mini figure by Jakks Pacific. Figure remains sealed in original packaging.
Package shows minor shelf wear including light creasing and edge wear from storage. Figure has never been opened or removed.
Please review photos carefully for condition of packaging and exact item you will receive.
